abilities.name: Normal Attack
_curatorNotes: Normal attack name and description are placeholders — the character JSON generator was not run for this character. Reviewer to merge genshin-db text on a future pass.
N2 and N3 each deal two hits (attackHitmarks: N2=[17,37], N3=[15,21]); per recipe, swap reflects the last hitmark and N2/N3 N-cancel frames are AnimationLength (46/53) so omitted.
Charged attack is 3 rapid hits (chargeHitmarks=[42,49,56]) with a single chargeFrames map per recipe; the swap/D/J/E/Q/N values reflect cancel windows opening after the final hitmark.

Plunge is only accessible via AirborneXianyun state in gcsim (LowPlungeAttack returns an error otherwise); plungeFrames recorded from lowPlungeFrames per recipe. High plunge variant exists (highPlungeFrames: swap=53, N=58, E=59, Q=60, D=46) but only one plungeFrames entry is supported by the schema.

abilities.name: Feathermoon Ring (N follow-up)
abilities.description: When pressed during the Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance leap-back window (66f after a successful Detect hit), N fires Feathermoon Ring instead of a normal attack — three Anemo hits at frames 38, 62, 85. Schema-typed as a skill (not a normal) because gcsim categorises it as `SkillState` with elemental-art ICD/scaling, even though the input is N.
_curatorNotes: gcsim categorisation: pressing N while leapBackStatus is active calls reathermoonRings() which returns action.SkillState with AttackTagElementalArt. So this entry is `abilityType: "skill"` despite the N input — more truthful than a normal-attack entry that would inherit normal-attack ICD.

Three hit frames from gcsim ringHitmarks=[38, 62, 85]; not authored as hits[] because SkillAbility's schema only carries a single FrameMap. Reviewer may extend the schema to support per-hit timing on stance-fired skill abilities.

Cooldown 0: gcsim's reathermoonRings does not call SetCD. ActionReady override returns true for E during leapBackStatus regardless of base skill CD — the in-stance follow-up bypasses the 16s skill cooldown. Same applies to the in-stance E variant below.
A4 (anemo mastery): each ring hit gains FlatDmg += EM × 3.09. Scaling buff — value field omitted per recipe; reviewer to wire as BuffValue.scaling with scalingStat 'em'.

A1 (Pliant Wind): if the parent Detect hit triggered an elemental absorption (Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo), each ring hit also fires a 'mixed' hit at 50% multiplier with the absorbed element (separate ICDGroup ICDGroupLanyanRingAttackMix, reset_timer=150). Recipe.md § 3.5 says don't author element-absorption-conditional damage; flagged here only.
C1 (Of Awakened Trees) extra hits at frames [38, 64, 90] when the absorbed element is non-Anemo. Same A1-conditional logic; not modeled, flagged on the C1 entry.

Casting this ability ends leapBackStatus (gcsim DeleteStatus(leapBackStatus) at top of reathermoonRings). The schema's stance window does not have an explicit 'in-stance ability ends stance' field; reviewer to handle in parser. The 1.1s stance duration on the base skill makes the practical impact small.

abilities.name: Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance
abilities.description: Lan Yan strikes forward with a brief detect hitbox at frame 7. If it hits an enemy, she leaps backwards, generating a Shield of Safe Transport-style Anemo shield (12.5s, scales off ATK + flat) and entering a 66f window during which her next N or E press fires Feathermoon Ring instead. The detect-miss path skips the leap-back window and uses a faster cancel slice (skillMissFrames: swap=49, N=45, Q=46, D=47, J=47).
_curatorNotes: Stance opens conditionally on detect-hit only. Frames above are gcsim's skillHitFrames (post-hit) — the standard rotation case. Miss-path cancel slice (skillMissFrames): swap=49, N=45, Q=46, D=47, J=47. Not authored as a separate ability; reviewer to flag a caveat for missed-detect rotations.

Hold parameter (0–610): shifts the detect hitmark to 7+hold and adds +hold frames to all cancel times. cooldownStartDelay = 4+hold. Min-hold (hold=0, the standard use) is captured here; max-hold cancel ≈ 80+610 = 690 frames. Not modelled; flag for hold-aware rotations.

Shield: 12.5s lifetime; ShieldHP = shieldAmt[talentLvl] × TotalAtk + shieldFlat[talentLvl] (ATK-scaling). Shield element type matches the absorbed element (defaults to Anemo). Not authored as scaling buff — schema's shield-tag captures presence; ATK-scaling shield value is a future schema extension.

C2 (Through Glistening Springs): on enemy hit by active char's normal attack while the shield is up, restores 40% of shield HP. ICD 2s. Not authored — schema has no 'on team-N hit while shield up' trigger; flagged on C2.
C6 (Of Hopes Fulfilled): Init() calls SetNumCharges(action.ActionSkill, 2), giving 2 skill charges at C6. Authored as chargeModifiers below.
Stance duration of 1.1s is gcsim's leapBackDuration (66 frames). terminatesOnSwap inferred from the BLOCKED-draft notes (stance is brief enough that this rarely matters in practice).

abilities.name: Feathermoon Ring (E follow-up)
abilities.description: When pressed during the Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance leap-back window, E re-fires the Feathermoon Ring (three Anemo hits at frames 38, 62, 85) — same frames and behavior as the N follow-up. Both inputs route to the same ringsFrames in gcsim; this entry exists so that 'E E' notation routes correctly.
_curatorNotes: Three hit frames from gcsim ringHitmarks=[38, 62, 85]; not authored as hits[] (single FrameMap only on skill abilities). Frames identical to lanyan__skill__feathermoon_ring_n above — both map to gcsim ringsFrames. The two entries differ only in `input`. See A1/A4/C1 flags on the N variant; same applies here.
ActionReady override (lanyan.go) returns true for E during leapBackStatus regardless of base skill CD; this in-stance E bypasses the 16s skill CD.

abilities.name: Lustrous Moonrise
abilities.description: Lan Yan summons a moonrise that deals three instances of Anemo DMG to opponents in the targeting circle. Hits at frames 30, 46, 51. C4 fires a 60 EM team buff for 12s on cast.
_curatorNotes: Three hits at gcsim burstHitmarks=[30, 46, 51], all sharing the same AttackInfo (50U gauge anemo, ICDTagElementalBurst). Schema-typed as a single burst frames map per recipe; multi-hit timing flagged here.
J omitted: burstFrames = InitAbilSlice(100) // Q - Jump with no explicit ActionJump override — default 100 is AnimationLength, not a valid cancel frame.
A4 (Liquid Moon): each burst hit gains FlatDmg += EM × 7.74. Scaling buff — value field omitted per recipe; reviewer to wire as BuffValue.scaling with scalingStat 'em'.
C4 (Of Wisp-Lit Glow): on Q cast, all party members gain +60 EM for 12s. Authored on the C4 constellation entry.

passives.name: Pliant Wind
passives.description: When the Detect hit of Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance lands on an enemy, Lan Yan performs an elemental absorption check (Pyro / Hydro / Electro / Cryo). If an aura is present, the resulting Anemo shield gains that element type, and each Feathermoon Ring hit additionally fires a 50%-multiplier hit of the absorbed element (separate ICD group ICDGroupLanyanRingAttackMix).
_curatorNotes: Element absorption — recipe.md § 3.5 says flag, don't author the per-element conditional damage. The mixed-element hits use ringHitmarks=[38, 62, 85] just like the base ring (separate ICD group; reset_timer=150).
Ascension level 1+. Not authored — schema lacks per-element absorption conditional triggers.

passives.name: A Thousand More Li
passives.description: Each Feathermoon Ring hit gains FlatDmg += EM × 3.09. Each Lustrous Moonrise burst hit gains FlatDmg += EM × 7.74.
_curatorNotes: EM-scaling FlatDmg buffs on ring (×3.09) and burst (×7.74) hits. Per recipe — not authored; values dependent on runtime EM. Reviewer to wire as BuffValue.scaling with scalingStat 'em' once schema is settled.
Ascension level 4+. The A4 contributions stack with A1's mixed-element hits (which inherit FlatDmg too in gcsim) — flagged for completeness.

constellations.name: Of Awakened Trees
constellations.description: When A1 (Pliant Wind) absorbs an element other than Anemo, Feathermoon Ring fires three additional mixed-element hits at frames 38, 64, 90 — same scaling as the base ring.
_curatorNotes: C1 extra hits ride on the A1 absorption check; only fire when the absorbed element is not Anemo. Frames from gcsim c1Hitmarks=[38, 64, 90]. Not modelled — schema gap on element-absorption-conditional damage.

constellations.name: Through Glistening Springs
constellations.description: When the active character lands a normal attack while protected by Lan Yan's shield, the shield restores 40% of its DMG absorption value. Triggers at most once every 2s.
_curatorNotes: Trigger: onHit by active char's normal attack while LanyanShield is up. ICD 2s (lanyan-c2-icd). Not authored — schema has no 'on team-N hit while shield up' trigger combined with 'restore shield by %'.
